mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate is positive in the prior quarter but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 4.0% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of subsequent 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal persistent inflationary pressures, prompting restrictive monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (CPIAUCSL > 310 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5) is met but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of subsequent 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1300 thousand units signal renewed consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 1300 thousand units during post-recession recovery but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of subsequent 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals expanding labor market conditions, increasing household income and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth is positive in the prior month but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and dampening economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of subsequent 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust economic activity across supply and demand channels, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (INDPRO > 102 and RSAFS > 705000) is met but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of subsequent 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 310), restrictive monetary policy implementation reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 310 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of subsequent 60 trading days.
